body: ### What are you really trying to do? Using encryption and some headers to propagate context. I have a failing LocalActivity - with a reasonably back off > Workflow Task - This results in Temporal durable Timer for LocalActivityBackoff One the Timer fires, I expect the Workflow task and LocalActivity complete successfully ### Describe the bug After the Timer fires, on WorkflowTask started- it results in attempt to run LocalActivity - however the payload converter throws the below error ### Minimal Reproduction https://github.com/gauravthadani/samples-dotnet/tree/main/src/Encryption ### Environment/Versions - OS and processor: [e.g. M1 Mac, x86 Windows, Linux] - Temporal Version: [e.g. 1.14.0?] and/or SDK version - Are you using Docker or Kubernetes or building Temporal from source? ### Additional context
title: [Bug] re-attempt of LocalActivity after a LocalActivityBackoff - leading to task failure
